div.b:
NON-TECHNICAL: Closer guesses get higher rewards, like playing 'hot and cold'. The further you are from the answer, the lower the score drops.
TECHNICAL: Exponential decay ensures continuous reward gradient for optimization. Within tolerance uses linear interpolation, outside uses exp(-x) for smooth falloff.
